commit_message: Complete ADR 0133 Remote AI Studio first release
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0133 Remote AI Studio first release
pr_body:
## Summary

- add a loopback-only HTTP/SSE Remote AI Studio gateway above the existing Agent Host
- keep local and remote AI Studio on the same authoritative session/run/permission/completion state
- add bounded idempotency, reconnect event cursors, sanitized remote DTOs, captured-frame retrieval, and a responsive web companion
- cover retry, reconnect, stale proposal, security boundary, and frame ownership contracts with integration-oriented tests

## Validation

Run the repository Windows Validation planner and Editor Visual Validation. Remote browser desktop/mobile viewport evidence is also required before ADR 0133 is considered complete.
